name: My Little Pony: Super Ethical Shipping Climax!
source:
A visual novel centered around the concept of “shipping” in the My Little Pony fandom. SFW-ish parody, it ranges from PG to M, depending on the rating agency. Nothing pornographic outside of sexual references and silly jokes.

Includes a lot of ponies. And shipping. And shipping ponies.

[From [url=https://caraffle.itch.io/sesc]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部圍繞《彩虹小馬》同人圈中「嗑CP」這一概念展開的視覺小說。本作屬於基本全年齡向的惡搞作品，根據不同分級機構的標準，尺度大致在輔導級到成熟級之間。除了性暗示和無厘頭笑話外，沒有任何色情內容。

包含大量小馬。以及嗑CP。以及給小馬配CP。

[引自[url=https://caraffle.itch.io/sesc]itch.io[/url]]
